hypothesis: High lagged market correlation makes unusually wide cross-sectional residual dispersion more likely to mean-revert, while compressed dispersion in the same common-mode regime supports only a small market-trend tilt.
falsifier: Reject the mechanism if the residual-reversal sleeve does not improve net risk-adjusted performance in high-correlation high-dispersion observations, or if gains vanish under doubled costs and across development folds.
formation_horizon: Rolling completed 8h bars: 42 days for correlation and beta, 7 versus prior 42 days for dispersion, 14 days for residual dislocation, and 21 days for market trend.
rebalance_horizon: Weekly at Monday 00:00 UTC, with orders left to the next executable open.
control_profile: Unlevered gross budget at most 0.90, absolute symbol target capped at 0.16, organizer volatility and drawdown scaling, and 0.20 maximum one-way turnover per rebalance.
